Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 87: September 2008
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #87 shipped to subscribers in August 2008 (bearing the cover date of September 2008 for Issue 87). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #87 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, extra DLC content, and exclusive media previews:

Sid Meier's Civilization Revolution (turn-based strategy)
Dragon Ball Z: Burst Limit (anime fighting game)
Battlefield: Bad Company (tactical squad-based FPS)
NASCAR 08 / NASCAR 09 (stock car racing simulation)
Sea Life Safari (Xbox Live Arcade underwater photography game)
Happy Tree Friends: False Alarm (Xbox Live Arcade physics puzzle-action)
Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Advanced Warfighter 2 (extra downloadable co-op content)

In addition to interactive gameplay and bonus DLC, the native 360 disc delivered downloadable gamerpics (including unlockable Half-Life 2 gamerpics), offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—including art galleries for Fable II and Gears of War 2, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
